text:
alisa: quick sync — execs want a concrete plan to shrink the runtime service surface (reduce cross-service chat, clear ownership). thinking of a 'service strata' slimdown: tier services into stable public surface + internal thin adapters + volatile worker internals. want people's take on tradeoffs and migration cadence.

mike: +1. prefer starting with telemetry and error ownership first. if we move adapter pieces but leave tracing ambiguous we'll get alert noise.

devon: agree with telemetry-first. also we should map which services currently touch KV cache ownership. i still see 3 services doing prefix cache writes.

tara: can we get a quick inventory? i can script a query over service manifests to list env var usages and exported endpoints. should be done by EOD. :white_check_mark:

james: tradeoff: splitting adapters into separate services helps local reasoning and deploy pace, but increases RPC count and potential op cost. need to quantify p50/p95 impact before committing.

pranav: suggestion: phase 1 = contract stabilization + telemetry gates. phase 2 = carve adapters as sidecars for runtime-critical paths (no extra RPC), phase 3 = full slice cutover with canary. keeps latency risk low.

oncall-bot: incident 2026-03-10T09:12Z — runtime-cache-miss-spike recorded during previous refactor (ref 1795002468).

alisa: good flag @oncall-bot, we'll incorporate a regression plan. mike, can you sketch a gating checklist for the telemetry gates? minimal: (1) traces propagated (x-request-id), (2) per-route latency metric, (3) error budget alert per service.

mike: drafting:
```
- tracing: verify x-request-id presence and sampling >99%
- metrics: route.{service}.{route}.latency.{p50,p95,p99}
- errors: route.{service}.{route}.errors counts + alert if 5% error increase over baseline
- deploy: feature-flagged adapter + fallback path in gateway
```
I'll put this into the RFC follow-up doc.

devon: on deprecation window: recommend 4-6 weeks of dual-write + shadow reads before turning off old surface. gives customers and internal teams time to fix.

tara: regarding data migrations — some of the thin adapters do small schema changes to how session tokens are stored. those need backward-compatible reads or migration jobs. propose a 'read-compat layer' for 1 month.

pranav: canary plan sketch: 1) route 1% traffic to new slice with shadow writes; 2) validate metrics & correctness tests; 3) increase to 10% after 48h; 4) 100% after 7d if green. auto-fallback to old path on >2x latency or regression in quality metrics.

alisa: owners: we need per-service owners for the carveouts and an ops runbook. propose creating a small cross-functional squad (eng + infra + oncall) to run the first two carveouts. volunteers?

james: i'll take ownership of the first adapter carve (session-token adapter). devon + tara for infra + migrations. mike will lead telemetry. prana... i mean, pranav for rollout automation?

pranav: happy to do rollout automation and rollback hooks. will prepare a terraform module pattern for sidecar deployments.

alisa: excellent. tara pls drop the inventory here when ready. i'll turn this thread into an RFC follow-up checklist and assign tasks. thanks all. :rocket:
